mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Probability chapter! You built a Naive Bayes classifier from scratch, implementing Bayes' theorem with Gaussian likelihoods. The classifier achieved 100% accuracy on the test set (the classes were well-separated). You computed log-odds ratios and implemented Maximum Likelihood Estimation. Probability is the mathematical foundation of machine learning — every prediction is a probability, every loss function measures probability discrepancy, and every model is a probability distribution over outputs. Combined with your linear algebra and calculus knowledge, you now have the mathematical toolkit for understanding and building ML systems.
